metadata.name: backstop_hook
metadata.description: BACKSTOP Token-2022 transfer hook: protocol allowlist, tenure accumulator and tenure-weighted reward accounting.

accounts.name: authority
docs: `backstop-offers` book PDA.

accounts.name: authority
docs: `backstop-core` market PDA (fee distributor).

instructions.name: execute
docs: SPL transfer-hook `Execute`, invoked by Token-2022 on every transfer.

instructions.name: grow_reward_state
docs: Grow the reward state by 10 KiB (call until `reward_ready`).

accounts.name: authority
docs: `backstop-chest` chest-market PDA.

instructions.name: initialize
docs: Create the hook config, extra-account-meta list and the first chunk of
the reward state for `mint`. Signed by the current mint authority.

accounts.name: mint_authority
docs: Current mint authority of `mint` (deployer at genesis; the launchpad
PDA for child tokens).

accounts.name: authority
docs: `backstop-core` market PDA.

errors.name: UnauthorizedProgram
errors.msg: Token movement initiated by a program that is not on the protocol allowlist

errors.name: UnauthorizedDestination
errors.msg: Destination owner is a program account that is not on the protocol allowlist

errors.name: DirectTransferToProtocolAccount
errors.msg: Direct transfers may only target wallet (on-curve) owners

errors.name: MissingImmutableOwner
errors.msg: Destination token account must have the ImmutableOwner extension

errors.name: NotTransferring
errors.msg: Hook invoked outside of a Token-2022 transfer

errors.name: MintMismatch
errors.msg: Token account does not belong to this mint

errors.name: InvalidTokenAccount
errors.msg: Account is not a Token-2022 account

errors.name: WrongHookProgram
errors.msg: Mint does not use this program as its transfer hook

errors.name: NotMintAuthority
errors.msg: Signer is not the current mint authority

errors.name: Unauthorized
errors.msg: Caller is not authorised for this instruction

errors.name: DirectSellCapExceeded
errors.msg: Direct AMM sells exceed the rolling per-wallet cap; create an offer instead

errors.name: DirectSellRequiresHolder
errors.msg: Direct AMM sells require a registered holder account

errors.name: RewardStateNotReady
errors.msg: Reward state is not fully initialised (call grow_reward_state)

errors.name: EpochCatchUpRequired
errors.msg: Reward epochs are too far behind; call advance_epochs first

errors.name: HolderMismatch
errors.msg: Holder account does not match the wallet or mint

errors.name: HolderNotEmpty
errors.msg: Holder still has a balance or unharvested rewards

errors.name: InvalidParameter
errors.msg: Invalid parameter

errors.name: AllowlistFull
errors.msg: Too many allowlist entries

errors.name: DuplicateAccount
errors.msg: Duplicate token account in sync list

errors.name: MathOverflow
errors.msg: Arithmetic error

errors.name: Unavailable
errors.msg: Requested data is unavailable

types.name: Holder
docs: Per-wallet tenure, weight and reward checkpoint.

types.name: HookConfig
docs: Market-level hook configuration (Borsh account, rarely written).

fields.name: reward_ready
docs: RewardState has reached its full size and is initialised.

fields.name: governance
docs: Governance (Squads multisig vault on mainnet).

fields.name: pending_governance
docs: Two-step governance transfer target (default = none).

fields.name: core_authority
docs: `backstop-core` market PDA: may deposit rewards and record burns.

fields.name: offers_authority
docs: `backstop-offers` book PDA: may credit absorb tenure.

fields.name: chest_authority
docs: `backstop-chest` chest-market PDA: may harvest rewards into chests.

fields.name: amm_authority
docs: `backstop-amm` pool PDA: transfers into it from wallets are direct sells.

fields.name: allowed_programs
docs: Programs that may be the top-level instruction of a token movement.

fields.name: allowed_owners
docs: Off-curve token-account owners permitted to receive tokens.

fields.name: tenure_cap_secs
docs: Average age at which the tenure multiplier caps (default 90 d).

fields.name: tenure_extra_bps
docs: Multiplier above 1.0 at the cap, bps (default 20_000 → 3.0×).

fields.name: absorb_tenure_bps
docs: Share of a seller's lot tenure transferred to absorbers (default 40 %).

fields.name: direct_sell_cap
docs: Rolling per-wallet cap on direct AMM sells (default = min offer size).

fields.name: link_min_amount
docs: Minimum direct transfer recorded in the recent-sender ring.

fields.name: epoch_secs
docs: Distribution epoch length — immutable after initialisation.

fields.name: genesis_ts
docs: Boundary 0 timestamp — immutable after initialisation.

types.name: RewardState
docs: Global reward accumulator + cap schedule ring for one market (~49 KB).

types.name: TransferTracked
docs: Emitted for every tracked token movement. `kind`: 0 = direct transfer,
1 = protocol-routed (AMM / offers / chest / launchpad).
